title: Earthior, before the impact
speaker: X GOD
caption: Before the meteor, Earthior was home.
School, friends... and homework to finish.
alt: Before the mutation, brown-haired X wears his familiar white shirt and orange cargo pants outside school on Earthior.

title: The sky tears open
speaker: X GOD
caption: Then a meteor tore through Earthior.
The impact ripped open dimensional time.
alt: A marked meteor strikes Earthior and tears open a violet dimensional rift.

title: Through the tear
speaker: X GOD
caption: Even as Earthior broke apart,
I was pulled into the tear.
alt: Brown-haired X is pulled through a violet dimensional tear, holding his folded worksheet.

title: Alone in the alley
speaker: X GOD
caption: Mom? Dad? Where's my sister?
No one answered.
alt: The ordinary brown-haired boy wakes alone in the purple-brick alley with his backpack and worksheet, before the Dragon arrives.

title: A strange alley
speaker: X GOD
caption: Then something found me.
Its fire should have been the end.
alt: The green horned Dark Dragon breathes magical fire toward X in a strange purple-brick alley.

title: The fire changed me
speaker: X GOD
caption: But that fire changed me.
It fled to the rooftops. I followed.
alt: Transformed X God studies his hands, with lime hair, X eyes and newly awakened elemental power.
